pulls.notes:
Three bugs, one fix:
1. plugins/model-providers/minimax/__init__.py — set models_url on all 3 profiles
   (default fetch_models hit <base_url>/models = .../anthropic/models → 404)
2. hermes_cli/models.py — add minimax, minimax-cn to _MODELS_DEV_PREFERRED
   (the gate that triggers live /v1/models fetch in list_authenticated_providers)
3. validate_requested_model — fix misleading comment about /v1/models endpoint

PRs 39815 and 39818 to NousResearch/hermes-agent were opened, then closed per
user instruction. The 39815 PR was conflicting (origin/main 5 commits behind
upstream/main). The 39818 PR was blocked at push by PAT scope (workflow file
from upstream requires 'workflow' scope that the current gh PAT doesn't have).

Local commit 2f99a1078 on branch fix/audit-findings-2026-05-28 in
/home/hermes-pi/hermes-agent contains the 4-file change (525 insertions,
17 deletions). The 3-way-merged version on /tmp/hermes-pr was discarded
when the push was blocked.

Upstream already has several recent MiniMax improvements (default_aux_model
changed to M3 in 3d1d0a49f, vision video_url handling in 0b46c4163, etc.) —
this patch is complementary: it adds the live /v1/models catalog discovery
to the picker, which is independent of those changes.
